subject.title: fix(swift): keep node routes valid in connected callbacks

question: Should `GatewayChannelActor.connect()` preserve a completion-order guarantee for generic hello-snapshot callbacks, or is delivery after connection completion intentionally allowed to be asynchronous?
rationale: The branch fixes a scheduler race by moving callback delivery into a new task, but that also changes the observable lifecycle boundary for route and session consumers; source-level intent must be confirmed by the native gateway owner.

options.title: Specify and test callback ordering
options.body: Define the intended relationship between connection completion and generic snapshot callbacks, then add focused coverage for that contract before merge.

options.title: Accept asynchronous delivery
options.body: Land the deferred delivery as an intentional contract change after confirming no consumer requires snapshot-derived route state immediately when `connect()` returns.

recommendation.title: Specify and test callback ordering
recommendation.body: Define the intended relationship between connection completion and generic snapshot callbacks, then add focused coverage for that contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence links this contributor to the affected native gateway lifecycle and adjacent reconnection work, though a fuller current-main ownership trace is needed for high confidence.
